verdict.rationale: Apple's macOS page says that bringing your iPhone near the Mac lets Setup Assistant sign you in to your Wi-Fi network and Apple Account (macos-docs-14), which is exactly the proximity-based setup this story describes. Migration Assistant is also positioned as making new-Mac setup quick, even from Windows (macos-docs-2). missing for 10: in-depth first-party setup documentation beyond a one-line marketing claim, detail on what else proximity setup configures beyond Wi-Fi and Apple Account, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
